Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Role Purpose
 Build automated test coverage, regression evidence and acceptance evidence inside the squad, so delivery decisions are based on repeatable proof.
 Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain automated test coverage for squad deliverables (functional, regression, integration, API, end-to-end).
Produce acceptance and regression evidence supporting sprint and gate decisions.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD for repeatable execution.
Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on priority components.
Provide defect analytics and quality-risk reporting to squad and governance.
Coach squad engineers toward squad-owned quality practices.
 Essential Skills & Experience
3-8+ years software testing and quality engineering with hands-on automation.
Python test automation; extending existing frameworks.
RESTful API testing: JSON, XML, HTTP, API authentication.
Git and CI/CD automated test execution (Azure DevOps, Jenkins or GitHub Actions).
Risk-based testing and automated regression pack design.
 Desirable
Real-time, event-driven or high-volume transaction systems.
Performance/load testing principles; SQL and database validation.
TestRail or similar test management tooling.
 Ways of Working
 Two-week sprints; daily stand-ups; weekly dependency and integration checkpoints; end-of-sprint show-and-tell; evidence-led reporting via FTRP governance; Jira.
